title: Power scaling of the uniform norm
statement: For a finite set $\Omega$, real numbers $p,c>0$, and a function $f:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$, the uniform $L^{p/c}$ quantity of $x\mapsto |f(x)|^c$ equals the uniform $L^p$ quantity of $f$, raised to the power $c$.
